basics.name: Muhammad Ahmad
basics.label: AI Engineer
basics.summary: AI engineer with hands-on production experience shipping autonomous agent systems and real-time voice AI end to end. Built and deployed 7+ production systems in the past year, including a voice agent reaching sub-1-second latency. Strong backend foundation (FastAPI, multi-database systems) paired with rigorous system design and production hardening practices.

work.name: VaconAI
highlights: Designed and shipped 7+ production AI/ML systems end to end across a multi-client engineering practice, owning architecture, implementation, and deployment from spec to production

Built a knowledge-graph service spanning three databases (Neo4j, MongoDB, Pinecone; 6 node types, 15 relationship types) that converts legal deposition transcripts into queryable contradiction and admission graphs in under 2 minutes end to end

Designed a two-stage extraction pipeline for the graph: deterministic parsing generates 200–300 nodes per transcript at zero LLM cost, then a concurrency-capped LLM pass adds 70–150 relationship nodes

Automated dispute resolution for an e-commerce payments platform with a 10-agent LLM routing system and a 4-tier offer-escalation ladder, replacing manual case handling with a bounded, trackable negotiation flow
Built automatic evidence pre-collection with a 3-tier order-lookup fallback (custom field → invoice ID → storefront search), staging dispute-specific evidence before any agent call runs

Built a real-time "co-counsel" feature streaming live transcription over WebSocket with a lease-based failover worker pool, and a 6-language automated return-processing pipeline for a customer-support platform

Built a production real-time voice agent with swappable local/cloud STT and TTS backends, reaching 0.7–1.0s voice-to-voice latency (vs. 2.4s all-local); extended to live phone calls via Twilio and a browser softphone

Built a six-phase autonomous content pipeline (keyword research, pillar/cluster mapping, content briefs, generation, on-page optimization) via Claude Code CLI in headless mode, then evolved it into a 24/7 self-operating system across 13 sites and 16 industries with a human-approval gate; published 364+ verified-live articles, growing organic search impressions 24% week over week
Built an MCP server exposing 17 tools across 9 research sources (Hacker News, Reddit, X, YouTube) with an offline-first cache of 8,400+ indexed transcripts
Engineered a resilient transcript-ingestion pipeline across 20 YouTube channels (1,000 candidates → 457 corpus chunks) with adaptive backoff

work.name: Freelance
highlights: Built a medical transport management system processing 500+ daily trips, with a reporting dashboard, data exports, and a CSV bulk-import pipeline with validation
Implemented backend APIs with advanced filtering, pagination, and aggregation for client management; delivered a private production deployment with invite-only access control
